independent_metric_clarification.continuous_executable_surface_coverage: 0.0% - zero genuine continuous exchange bid/ask surface.
independent_metric_clarification.methodological_distinction: Paired quote observations measure discrete instances where Bid > 0 and Ask > 0. Continuous executable surface coverage measures whether executable Bid/Ask spreads exist across the option chain throughout the trading session. These metrics are strictly independent; neither implies the other.
